Garden Dimensions: Class 10 pair of linear equations word problem, step by step, by elimination. Board exam se pehle pakka karo.

• Let length = x m and width = y m
• Half the perimeter = length + width, so x + y = 36 (not 2(x + y))
• Length is 4 m more: x - y = 4
• Add the two equations: 2x = 40, so x = 20
• Put it back: y = 16. Length 20 m, width 16 m
